exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Fail 'chip select idle high': the F suffix defaults low on input power loss, which drives CS and SCK low and selects the monitor while the host side is unpowered. Source cited: Pins.md:151-155.
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The requirement is P2's extension of Pins.md:151-155, which covers only the coprocessor in reset: the pads come out of reset pulled down 32 to 86 kohm and the external pull-up of about 10 kohm holds each chip select high. In that case the barrier input is high and an F part also outputs high. The host-unpowered case is stated in no requirement of Research.md, IOBoard.md or Pins.md, and no figure read shows that CSB held low with SCK and SDI low, while the host side is unpowered, harms the ADBMS1818 or exceeds V190. All four parts pass the other requirement values on rank 1's data sheet and have stock above the gate (JLCPCB, vendors.py jlcpcb, read 2026-10-02T00:51:15Z: C2872241 125/99; C2877510 4469/4454; C485810 1086/1066; C5216433 1144/1137). The drop stands only if the owner adds the host-unpowered requirement. No shortlist rank depends on it, since the default-high rows ISO7741DWR, ISO6741DWR and ISO7041DBQR pass.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Left outside the three survivors because its second-vendor route fails: Digi-Key stock 0, Active, 18 weeks. Its rule 5 would rest on ISO7741DWR, which has the same pin functions.
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Rule 5 passes on its first branch, a pin-compatible alternate that passes rules 1 to 4 and works in the same circuit, and P2's own text names that alternate. The pins match: ADuM1400/1401/1402 Rev. M Table 17 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ADuM1400_1401_1402.pdf, safari, HTTP 200, read 2026-10-02T00:52:51Z) gives 1 VDD1, 2 GND1, 3 VIA, 4 VIB, 5 VIC, 6 VOD, 7 VE1, 8 GND1, 9 GND2, 10 VE2, 11 VID, 12 VOC, 13 VOB, 14 VOA, 15 GND2, 16 VDD2, and ISO7740/7741/7742 SLLSEP4K Table 4-1 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/iso7741.pdf, HTTP 200, read 2026-10-02T00:52:51Z) gives the same pins 1 to 16 for the ISO7741 (EN1 and EN2 on pins 7 and 10, enabled when open in both). Both default high on input power loss. So the stated reason does not exclude it. Its IDD2 is 1.2 typ, 1.8 mA max at DC to 1 MHz (Table 3, 5 V), against 6.4 mA for rank 1; JLCPCB stock 2850/2789 at 5.5452 (P2, 2026-10-02T00:24:02Z). It is a candidate for rank 3 on those figures; whether it ranks above ISO7041DBQR is the re-rank's call.

missed_functions.why: IOBoard.md:524 lists 'its balance-lead input network ... not stated (R9)' as an open item of the cell monitor. It is the per-tap resistors and capacitors in front of the ADBMS1818's C pins, so its part is a resistor or capacitor. Research.md (Round 2, Rules of stage 1) says such a function is returned without candidates and left to stage 2; P2 returned no entry for it, and FU-2P1's P1-R9 function list names only 'Cell monitor' and 'cell monitor isolation barrier'.

IOBoard.md:524 names 'protection against a mis-plugged lead' and IOBoard.md:575 puts ESD and overvoltage protection on the balance-lead connector in round 2; Research.md Scope row 2 and the stage 1 rules leave it to stage 2 and require an entry without candidates. P2 returned none. P2's rank 1 reason relies on this function ('stage 2's balance-lead protection for a reversed lead'), and V188 (85 V) and V191 (shifted lead, reversed 67.2 V) are its requirement values.

IOBoard.md:524 names 'the balance-lead connector sizes'; V192 (owner, 2026-09-28) fixes 1 connector of 16 cells, 17 pins, with each pack's leads arriving through an adapter lead. Connectors are selected in stage 2 and are returned without candidates in stage 1. P2 returned no entry.

V193 (owner, 2026-09-28): no jumper or adapter lead sets the cell count and 'the board ties unused inputs itself'. That is a function of the board, in front of the monitor's inputs, not named in the R9 row or IOBoard.md. P2 returned no entry. Its part is not stated: if resistors or diodes it is stage 2; if an active part it is a stage 1 part. P2's rank 1 reason also requires V+ held at 16 V or more for packs under 16 V, which implies a supply referenced to the pack's negative; that supply is in no function list.
